D-grouse-atv-0106.name: 260 m NE of Ainslie Creek
D-grouse-atv-0106.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
D-grouse-atv-0106.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS).
4 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Route enters a Motor Vehicle Closed Area: Thompson, Cariboo and Okanagan Alpines. Closed Year Round. Exemption: Snowmobiles exempt year round (January 1 to December 31). Synopsis map 1-82/24.
Above 1,700 m: in Region 3 no motor vehicles except snowmobiles, except on existing roads and trails (synopsis page 33, 99%). Elevation from terrain tiles (estimate).

seasonRows.notes: youth only: hunters under 18 (page footnote); New, printed green
MU 3-14 is not listed in the Region 3 sharp tailed grouse rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from Merritt, about 56 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.94104, -121.33193, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 2.1 km to the start. Ride: the unnamed road stretch, 4.1 km one way. About 82 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-14, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-04, private land 2026-09-26, closures 2026-10-03.

D-moose-walk-0097.name: 3.5 km NE of East Anderson River
D-moose-walk-0097.pressureWhy: 3.4 km on foot from the nearest parking (estimate).
D-moose-walk-0097.parkWhat: pull off on Uztlius-East Anderson FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: 5 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 0.9 ha, right here.
Cutblock harvested 2020 (6 years old), 80 m SW: browse.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

seasonRows.notes: Bag 1; spike fork bulls: antlers must accompany the species licence (page footnote)

plan: Drive: from Merritt, about 73 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.73475, -121.31392, pull off on Uztlius-East Anderson FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 3.4 km NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 739 m, about 141 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip). Also: black bear (see evidence).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-14, Region 3. Season: moose spike fork bulls Nov 1 to Nov 15 (synopsis page 34, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-04, private land 2026-09-26, closures 2026-10-03.
